book.name: 1 TESALONIKA
book.title: 1 TESALONIKA Tesalonika mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Yesus prowam tuku ait mambilmba minap
O tira kame, Suŋgo nu ginu ait mbolŋge prowamŋgat ye ta tuku kuyar ndawet.
Suŋgo tuku ait kuayar taŋgo nu pitik furir prote taŋaŋ mayok kaŋgat ta tane kila.

Taŋgo nane sine mine mayeweg ŋguwaig le Suŋgo nu pitik ndo prowa le kuma kuma nane mbolŋge prowamŋgat. Pino nu kiŋo te-palmbim ŋga pitik rar tate taŋaŋ nane mbolŋge prowamŋgat. Nane piti ta laipe nda.
O tira kame, tane ma furir sinamŋge mine ndakade. Ait ta prowa le kuayar taŋgo prote le nane piriri ŋayode taŋamba tane piririwe nda.
Sine ŋakmba bulu tuku kiŋo kame minmba ma make ko furir mine ndakeg. Sine mafeŋ mineg.
Ta tuku afu kinyanu taŋaŋ minig ta sine kinye ndakube. Sine wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak mambilmba minbe.
Kinyig mbal nane furir ait mbolŋge kinyig. Kule kamenu nyade mbal nane furir kule nyumba ŋginŋgankade.

Sine taŋamba kuga. Sine mafeŋ mineg tukunu sine wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak minmba kame taŋgo nuŋe ŋgaro kigraibkam tuku agaŋ patikade taŋamba patikube. Sine ŋgamuŋgal son kume pur maŋau kilmba tawo soŋgam tuku agaŋ taŋaŋ silikube. Kuate nu sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋgit alonu ta minde minmba hat kareŋnu taŋaŋ kaikube.
Sine Kuate tuku gubra kaŋgeram tuku nu sine pati ndakina. Kuga. Sine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus mbolŋge muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku patikina.
Nu prowamŋgat ta sine abo minbe le ko kumbe le sine nu ndoŋ minmba minam tuku nu sinenu ŋga kumna.
Ta tuku tane taŋgine taŋgine wamdus piti kile-ibeŋka muŋgu saŋgri piletiŋgig taŋamba ndo minmba minap.
Wam pagu pasa yeki yeki
O tira kame, taŋgine gabat kame nane Suŋgo tuku maŋau tumtiŋmba tane kile-tidiŋgam tuku riroŋ pasa satiŋgig ta tane nane tuku nyu idusniŋmba kumnemŋge minap.
Nane Kuate tuku piro kade tukunu nane tuku kume purka nane tuku nyu idusniŋgap. Tane taŋgine taŋgine wamdus mukuk ŋak minap.

O tira kame, taŋgine taŋgo afu ake kaloimba likade ta riroŋ pasa niŋgap. Afu wamdus piti ŋak ta taŋgine pasambi nane tuku piti kile-ibeŋkap. Nane afu ŋgamuŋgal son saŋgri kugatok ta sinzaŋniŋmba turkap. Taŋgo ŋakmba ŋgamukŋge gubra kugatok ŋgan minap.
Nane afu tane ŋaigo siglikuwaig ndeta maŋau ndui tambi lafu ndawap. Taŋgine tira kame ko taŋgo ŋakmba mbolŋge wam magenu ke likam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu palpe.
Tane mara mara gare ŋak minmba
Kuate yabaŋmba minap.
Tane mbolŋge wam afu prode ta tuku Kuate gare ndo tape. Tane Kristus Yesus tuku mbal taŋamba kam tuku Kuate nu nzalite.
Tukul Guwa nu pa taŋaŋ tane mbolŋge uge ŋak minit ta fu ndawap.
Nane afu Tukul Guwaŋge pasa tumniŋgig le kile-mayokkade ta pasa ta talaka pitai ndawap.
Tane wam ŋakmba pileŋga wam ŋaigonu ŋgumneniŋmba wam magenu ta ndo biye dewap.

Ŋgamuŋgal mukuk wamdus bulok maŋau Kuate nu tugu. Nuŋge tane tiŋreknu kile-mayokkuwa. Nu tane kulatka minwa le ma ma siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus prowa le taŋgine ŋgaro ŋgamuŋgal kanu ta ŋakmba mbar kugatok purfeŋnu mayok kaŋgaig. Sine taŋamba tane tuku ŋga Kuate yabaŋeg.
Kuate nu tane wikate ta nu siŋka taŋamba kamŋgat.
O tira kame, tane sine tuku yabaŋap.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine tira kame ndoŋ muŋgu kume purkade maŋau ta alonu te-mayokap.
Ye Suŋgo tuku nyu mbolŋge pasa te satiŋget. Waŋe te burkap le tira kame ŋakmba iswaig.
Siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane ŋakmba make patikuwa. Son.
